physicalDetails.detail: Small, bald as an egg, sleeves rolled to the elbow, leather apron gone black down the front; hands and forearms scrubbed red to the wrists and split across every knuckle, goose grease in the cracks. Knees crack when he stands.

voiceMarkers.detail: Practical, a little sour, unflustered: 'Dalaran.' (said 'as if it were a long way off, and to blame'), 'I do teeth and bones, mostly. Births.', 'What happened to those?', 'Want me to look at them?', 'Tobin's the one with the bed.', 'No bread. I heard you the first time.' Hedges only at what he does not know ('Is it fever?').

beliefs.belief: It is fever; willow bark, vinegar cloths, warmth and no draughts; bleeding (he bled Garran the day before; it did no good and he won't again).
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Partly wrong: it comes on like fever but is a swallowed contamination.

beliefs.belief: It must be the water (three wells and the brook past the tannery).
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Wrong (a little in the water only); he accepts it is bread.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Keep the sick in the chapel, give them oat porridge (Mother Haw's), no bread; keep a bed made up for the next one.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Grey-faced and steady; sat with a candle by Garran's bed while Jaina was out; has taken the 'no bread' order though Ellen is 'a good girl'.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Sent for by Brask's militia to the chapel; showed Jaina the longest-ill (Garran) and the newest (Elsie); wrote a slate for her in big capitals (GARRAN, COOPER, WIFE, COOPER, BOY, ELSIE, COL, WENNA DUNMORE); named the wells and the lanes; knew who ate what.
Tipped Garran's sops into the slop bucket when told; fed oatcakes soaked in milk instead.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Knows who owes him for which tooth: a mental census of the village (houses, wells, who lodges where, who is mean enough not to dig a well). Keeps beds made up for new cases (a bed kept for each of three more in the cooper's house).

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Col
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'Tobin's an old woman' said to Jaina; Tobin: 'Tobin's the one with the bed.'

howHeAddressesOthers.pattern: No name; speaks to her as 'Dalaran' once and then plain questions.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Carries a basin with both hands; wipes his hands on his apron; knees to the floor to spoon sops into Garran's mouth with an arm under his head; rubs the slate pencil along his jaw when he thinks; sets the basin down hard enough to slop it when he disagrees; tongue between his teeth when he writes in square capitals.

knowledge.detail: Knows which house draws from which well (Cooper's Lane well: cooper's household, Garran, Col at the forge; top farm has its own; Ashby's draws from the brook), Garran's circumstances (wife gone since spring; had his teeth out at Midsummer; lives on sops), and that Ellen's mam bakes. Learns that it is bread.

arc.truth: A swallowed contamination in the bread.
arc.currentPosition: Convinced, obedient to the new order, hostile to nothing but the sickness.
